info.description: Cambrian's API provides real-time and historical blockchain data for DeFi agents. Cambrian data can be accessed directly by autonomous financial agents and integrated into smart contracts to optimize automated decision-making. Financial data available via Cambrian's API includes prices, wallet data, and DeFi metrics like liquidity pool statistics. Currently, Cambrian data covers the Base and Solana ecosystems.
